title: Jerry Jones compares Cowboys' unusual international schedule to 'night out on the town'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jerry Jones compares Cowboys' unusual international schedule to 'night out on the town'
sources.description: The league’s two prior games in South America were staged Friday of Week 1, allowing teams no close prior competition and two extra days of rest on the back end. Consider Jones in line with the changing international games policy.
